set.outcome:
**Generator wave 6 — a library, a costume, and a memory.** Three additions, each a control or data, no new `page.js` per state. `MODEL` is still **3**: `gen.js` and `rules.js` were not touched and all six proof seeds hash identically before and after.

![](gallery.png)

**1 · [Spec gallery](/framework/core/Page/generator/specs/)** — the readme has always said *keep a tree you like as its text*, and there was nowhere to keep it. `specs.js` is eight page shapes that are real things (docs site, inbox, settings rail, gallery, dashboard, reference, shop, handbook) as `{ title, note, spec }` data, drawn with the permutation wall's own `sketch()`. *Proof:* all eight render at their own `#s=` address with the textarea matching the source byte for byte; a card click runs `pick()`, which types the spec **and** opens its first root.

**2 · Look switcher** — `finder / cards / ink`, a third chip row in the header, stamping one class on the columns host. *Proof:* measured per look — cards puts the body on `--surface` with a 6.4px margin and a shadow on a `--wash` row; ink takes row and body to `#3f3f3f` with `--line` remapped. The control column stays light in all three (`:not(.page-gen-controls)`) — an instrument that goes dark with its subject is a control you cannot read.

![](look-ink.png)

The finding worth keeping: **ink is five tokens on the body, not a rule per part.** Everything a generated column draws is already written in `--line` / `--tint` / `--surface` / `--ink` / `--subtle`, so redeclaring those five redresses the bars, chips, media stand-ins, item colours and 3px sketches at once.

**Does colstyles' own CSS reach a generated tree?** Measured on `/generator/#42`, three states. The class alone does **nothing** — that stylesheet is only loaded under `/imagine/`, and `core/` may not import it. Loaded by hand it *does* dress row, body, head and title (those read core's class names; the title goes 800 + uppercase) but the nav item stays `#6a6a6a` in all three: colstyles styles `.page-column-item` and a generated column draws `.page-gen-item`. The forbidden import would have arrived half-dressed, so the looks are written in `generator.css`.

**3 · `store()`, and the split it makes explicit** — **the url carries the tree, the store carries the dressing.** `#7` / `#s=…` stays the tree and only the tree; `size`, `gap`, `look` and the last address ride in core's new `this.store()`. *Proof:* set ink + large + an Inbox spec, reload the **bare** `/generator/` with no hash — all three chips and the spec came back. The url still wins: `#42` under a stored spec lands on seed 42, proof line green.

**Verified** — six seeds identical before and after (`#1 991d25bc543f · #7 1d5901c444dc · #42 a332499027a8 · #99 1d34ff076163 · #1234 dbe5a58ae750 · #90210 aa993d0f6e9f`); zero console errors across the generator, `/specs/`, `/rolls/`, both docs pages and all three looks; 400 / 1920 / 3440 (gallery grid = 1 / 6 / 11 tracks). The one 404 seen is pre-existing and not this task's — `Page.file()` probes `readme/page.js` before falling back to the `.md`.

**Left, in priority order** — a copy-address button (the address is this module's whole artifact and there is still no button to take it); arriving deeper than one root, which is why 1920 is still mostly grey, and which fights Back; feedback in the spec box for an unrecognised word (it silently becomes `prose`); saving *your* spec into the gallery, which is 1 + 3 and deliberately not built in the same wave as either; exporting a tree as real `page.js` files, the actual endgame. **Cut:** depth/chaos dials (a dial makes `#7` mean many trees), a two-seed diff, filtering the rolls wall.
